versions.content: Actively query the status of a partial network Very much like mode management, the concept of partial networking supports the ability to actively query the status of a partial network. This can be done by means of interfacing the BSW in three alternative (as in one of) ways: • ComM : ClientServerInterface using the standardized ComM_UserRe- quest . GetCurrentComMode [20] • ComM : ModeSwitchInterface using the standardized ComM_CurrentMode . currentMode [20] • BswM : ModeSwitchInterface using the standardized AppModeInter- face . currentMode [14]
